title: feat(rust): qualify checked vector projection APIs and proofs
explanation: Frontend already accepted a statically in-range Vector index and transported tuple_index, while Rust owners admitted tuples only. Add a checked Vector projection fact with existing FixedVector<T,N> API and source bounds, rather than a new public executor/index trait. Genuine generated APIs, compile-fail controls and selected proof/application cases expose the semantic gap precisely.

title: feat(rust): integrate typed tuple return wrappers (#692)
explanation: TS accepted inferred Field pairs around terminal Set effects, while Rust required explicit component casts. Actual return remains (Field, Field) or typed mixed tuple. No new IR/ABI/builder; no arbitrary arity/product admission.

title: fix(rust): compose product children in outer Vector widening

title: feat(rust): preserve wide Uint multiplication by typed zero (#700)
explanation: x: Uint<200>; x * 0 was legal source but refused. Applicability is based on canonical declared bounds, never runtime operand values. Evaluate both operands once left-to-right before constructing zero so failures/witnesses remain visible. Existing checked WideUint/BoundedUint carriers suffice. Zero-singleton proof encoding exposed a separate gap; selected successful proof APIs use Uint8 and do not imply singleton result proof support.

title: fix(compiler): preserve Ledger 9 ZKIR impact boundaries
explanation: Standalone Counter proof passed but transaction prover exhausted skip entries. The old v3 emitter grouped expanded ledger operations; Ledger9 consumes one skip entry per transcript operation. Preserve those boundaries and omit suppressed operations. Counter's three impact instructions then match released output; exact IR supports standalone verification plus separately proved funded default-strict transaction/replay. Concrete reason a ledger migration is more than Cargo edits.
